segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Eh, still a bit groggy, but okay lah. Got some pain here at the tummy, you know?

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Understandable. Can you rate the pain for me, like on a scale of 1 to 10?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Maybe around 4 or 5? Not too bad, but I can feel it when I move.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Alright, we’ll manage that with some meds. Any nausea or feeling like you want to vomit?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: No nausea, but my throat got a bit sore. Like something stuck there?

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: That’s from the LMA tube during surgery. Should ease up soon. Breathing okay otherwise?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Yes, breathing’s fine. Just a little discomfort when I cough.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Good. Any memory of the operation itself? Sometimes people have bits they recall.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Nope, all black out. Woke up just now like that.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Perfect. Since you’ve got GERD, any acid reflux or chest discomfort post-op?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Not really. Stomach feels okay, just the usual tummy ache from surgery.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Great. We’ll keep an eye on your BP and lipids as usual. Any other concerns?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: No, all good. Thanks for checking on me.
